card.name: Ends of capitalized acronyms and HTML tags
card.fires_on: The last piece of an all-caps acronym such as OMRA, ESAs or GCH, and the closing '>' or quote of an HTML tag. It appears in label text and web pages.

modes.label: Acronym endings
modes.description: Final letters of an all-caps abbreviation, often right after an opening capital stem.

modes.label: HTML tag closings
modes.description: The end of a link or table tag, just before the visible text begins.

card.plain: It fires at the end of a capitalized abbreviation or at the close of a web code tag.
